scope_summary: Implemented the bounded additive CI extension: shared host fixture gates and release entrypoint, separate official Linux artifact preparation/smoke and container scripts, thin existing workflow, documentation and offline script tests. Installer/source/contracts/design and previous review records are unchanged. Native Linux, hosted CI, real upstream smoke, container/release execution, A1-A6 rollout checks and AC1 delivery history remain pending; stop for independent CI-delta review.

changes.intent: Run shared fmt, locked strict all-target Clippy, a current host binary build with Cargo-reported absolute executable injected into Rust test child env, locked Rust tests, Python worker suite and script tests; expose locked release entrypoint; fail on missing tools or ineffective Linux permission denials.
Retain compatible Bash entrypoint as argument/exit forwarding only, without a duplicate gate list.

Preserve default official release selection with optional exact tag, download into a fresh private directory, require and verify the exact binary SHA256 before chmod/execution, print tag/hash, call consumer and clean only owned contained artifacts.
Keep no-download consumer and ignored smoke while requiring native x86_64 Linux, an absolute executable, repository cwd and explicit native Rust host target.
Build/load existing local tag, verify Compose and invoke unchanged in-container assertions; accept only optional cache arguments, never publish or start production runtime installation.
Retain triggers, concurrency, matrix and rust/docker jobs with Python setup, repository rustup selection/components, caches and short script calls; explicitly restrict token to contents:read.
Cover gate order, failure propagation, current Cargo artifact selection, child-only env, cwd, prerequisites, Linux denial preconditions and host release build using stdlib mocks.
Offline shell-stub coverage for checksum fail-closed behavior, release selection, cleanup, platform/host checks, container calls/cache restriction and wrapper forwarding.
Document exact entrypoints, prerequisites, fixture/acquisition separation, networked smoke/build boundaries, evidence expectations and non-claims.
Update Development commands and link validation guide; all accepted operational text preserved.
